reconcile.note: Keil and Delitzsch identify Matthew's whale as the same loosely defined Greek term the Septuagint uses for Jonah's great fish, not a rival species.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Dennis McKinsey calls Matthew's whale for Jonah's fish the most famous biological error attributed to Jesus, since whales are mammals, not fish.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Dennis McKinsey (1995), The Encyclopedia of Biblical Errancy (1995).

sides.snippet: Yahweh prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah
sides.verseText: Yahweh prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah, and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.

sides.snippet: Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the whale
sides.verseText: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the whale, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
